title: Billing Office Determination: Home Delivery Charge Amount on Paid-in-Full Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
**Determination.** The home delivery charge on a delivered Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program paid in full at order is the program's home delivery fee, billed once on the order as a home delivery fee line. The charge is 0.00 when the program's free-delivery threshold is above 0.00 and the order total billed on the order is at or above it, and no home delivery charge is billed on an order linked to an installation contract. The charge is an amount in US dollars rounded to the nearest cent.

## Terms used

- **The program's home delivery fee** and **the program's free-delivery threshold** are the figures of the order's program in the Ridgeline Special Order Services home delivery tariff; a threshold of 0.00 means the program has none.
- **The order total billed** is the amount of the order billing line on the order — the order total billed on the order date.
- **Linked to an installation contract** means the order records a linked Ridgeline Installation Services contract.

## Decision table

| Order linked to an installation contract | Program threshold above 0.00 and order total billed at or above it | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | none billed |
| no | yes | 0.00 |
| no | no | the program's home delivery fee |

## Worked figures (hypothetical program figures and orders)

| Program fee | Program threshold | Order total billed | Linked | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 79.00 | 0.00 (none) | 1200.00 | no | 79.00 |
| 8.99 | 45.00 | 40.00 | no | 8.99 |
| 8.99 | 45.00 | 45.00 | no | 0.00 |
| 8.99 | 45.00 | 60.00 | no | 0.00 |
| 79.00 | 0.00 (none) | 1200.00 | yes | none billed |

## Basis questions

**Is the charge billed more than once on an order?** No; it is billed once, as one home delivery fee line.

**Does a threshold of 0.00 make every delivery free?** No. A threshold of 0.00 means the program has no free-delivery threshold, so the program's home delivery fee is charged.
